label: Root README is 1773 lines across 17 H2 sections with no table of contents; front matter is lines 1-10, SUMMARY starts at 11 and RELATED DOCUMENTS at 1751.

Four catalog sections hold 898 of 1773 lines (50.6%): SPEC KIT 304 (260-563), COMMAND LIBRARY 283 (1172-1454), SKILL LIBRARY 162 (799-960), PLUGIN & EXTENSION LIBRARY 149 (1023-1171). No other section exceeds 143 lines.

Doctor commands occupy 129 of the 283 COMMAND LIBRARY lines (1314-1442) while system-skilled-doctor/README.md is 144 lines owning the same eleven commands; 45.6% of the catalog duplicates one skill README.

All 14 skill READMEs share one skeleton (OVERVIEW, QUICK START, HOW IT WORKS, INTEGRATION & NAVIGATION, VERIFICATION, RELATED DOCUMENTS); 3179 lines total, mean 227. system-spec-kit/README.md is 716 lines and carries its own COMMANDS (36) and CONFIGURATION (52) sections.

Nine of fourteen skill READMEs are not linked from the root README: cli-classifier, cli-external-orchestration, cli-orca, local-webflow, mcp-code-mode, mcp-tooling, sk-doc, sk-git, sk-prompt. Linked: sk-code 3, system-spec-kit 2, system-skill-advisor 2, system-deep-loop 1, system-skilled-doctor 1.

.skilled/hooks/README.md is 436 lines and already owns the hook coverage story (DIRECTORY TREE 157, COVERAGE MATRIX 50); the root already defers to it at README.md:1168, so the pattern can be extended rather than invented.

INSTALL-SKILLED.md is 368 lines and owns install plus link-versus-copy; the root duplicates two npm build blocks (166-180) and a 10-line section 5 that only points at the guide, while section 4 already links out at lines 164 and 249.
Ordering inversion: install starts at line 160 of 1773 (9% depth) behind 149 lines of positioning, and the only link hub (RELATED DOCUMENTS, about 20 links) is the final section at line 1751.
Runtime support is stated as six runtimes at README.md:15 and as eight at README.md:184, and no runtime matrix section exists anywhere in the root README.

Section 3 OVERVIEW spends 49 of its 70 lines on one ASCII flow diagram (111-159), the largest prose-free block in the front matter and a candidate to move behind the ARCHITECTURE.md link already present at line 1770.

Proposed five-tier reader-first order: tier 1 first screen (pitch, capability bullets, runtime matrix, documentation map) <=60 lines; tier 2 get running (install, doctor setup, first task, own project) <=120; tier 3 how it works (gates, spec kit concept, deep loop, advisor, code mode) <=120; tier 4 catalogs as tables (skills, agents, commands, hooks) <=120; tier 5 reference (configuration, git worktrees, FAQ) <=100. Projected 500-620 lines from 1773.

Shrink map: section 6 to system-spec-kit/README.md; section 12 DOCTOR to system-skilled-doctor/README.md; section 9 to the 14 skill READMEs; section 11 to hooks/goal, hooks/session-handover and hooks/README.md; sections 13, 8, 7 to their skill READMEs; section 14 and the git-hooks note to scripts/git-hooks/README.md; section 15 adapting to sk-code/README.md; install prose and section 5 to INSTALL-SKILLED.md. Every target exists on disk.

direction: grep -c on section names as a duplication measure
reason: Title-level matching cannot distinguish a section that repeats content from one that links to it; the line-span measurement replaced it.

direction: Treating section 17 RELATED DOCUMENTS as the navigation answer
reason: It holds about 20 links but omits nine of fourteen skill READMEs, so it is a partial index rather than the map.

label: A section span set is only trustworthy when the spans reconcile to the file total; 1763 plus 10 front matter lines equals the 1773-line wc total.

.skilled/skills holds 15 skill directories, all with SKILL.md, but only 14 carry a README.md: sk-design has none. The root README asserts 14 skills at README.md:805, so the catalog undercounts by one and sk-design content has no skill README to shrink into.
A shrink map may only route content to a file that exists; sk-design has no README.md, so its catalog entry must stay in the root or gain a README first.
